summary: The GenericDocument component manages document records, their metadata, and associated user and agency information. It provides methods and logic for retrieving, adding, validating, formatting, deleting, and sorting documents, supporting workflows involving assignment, inheritance, and sorting across different parent entities. The system includes business rules for document validity, sorting by database or section, and user access control for editing and applying documents.
purpose: To provide a unified and flexible mechanism for handling documents within the HSPnet system, supporting operations like retrieval, assignment, sorting, validation, and deletion, and connecting documents with user, agency, and site contexts.

workflows.name: Document Retrieval by ParentID
steps: Set stored procedure name based on parent entity (Agency, Site, Destination).
Add session and entity parameters.
Invoke database procedure to retrieve document data.
Populate document list from result set.
Sort documents by section or database order as required.

workflows.name: Document Addition and Validation
steps: Check if file URL is blank, TypeCodeID is zero, or DocumentName is empty.
Add error messages for invalid fields.
If valid, set session procedure and parameters.
Insert document into database and return assigned ID.

workflows.name: Document Deletion
steps: Retrieve document record by ID.
Attempt to delete file and directory from filesystem.
Ignore file deletion exceptions.
Delete database record by executing relevant procedure.

workflows.name: Document Assignment
steps: Set procedure name for assignment (e.g., SiteDocumentAppliedDestinationsAssign).
Add relevant parameters (SessionID, DocumentID, DestinationCodeIDList).
Execute database query for assignment.

workflows.name: Inherited Document Retrieval
steps: Parse Discipline/SubDiscipline ID.
Set section usage flag if section data exists.
Retrieve and fill document list including inherited logic.
Order and verify documents based on sort and section.

business_rules: Document is valid only if file URL is present or ID is nonzero.
TypeCodeID and DocumentName are required fields.
Documents may not be editable depending on SourceLevel and user permissions.
Documents sorted by database order or by section depending on available data.
validations: FileURL cannot be blank for new document.
Valid email is formatted as mailto link or blank if missing.
calculations: Inherited title text is constructed for document links.
conditions: If SourceLevel is Agency or Site, adjust inherited title text.
If IsApplied is false, document link is shown in grey.
Use alt-language fields if session specifies.
system_behavior: Documents are returned as formatted links with metadata.
Errors are handled silently on file/deletion failures.
Documents not found in filesystem are flagged.
Database operations encapsulated in session-based procedures.
dependencies: Document retrieval depends on session and parent entity data.
Sorting depends on SortOrder table and section field.
Assignments depend on correct destination code lists.
exceptions: Documents not found are flagged with 'Document_Not_Found'.
Invalid documents return error messages and halt workflow.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling logic for database failures.
No documentation for user role permission boundaries.
No details on UI presentation beyond link formatting.
Workflow steps partially inferred due to fragmented context.
